title: WEATHER-R1: LOGICALLY CONSISTENT REINFORCEMENT FINE-TUNING FOR MULTIMODAL REASONING IN METEOROLOGY
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving 'logical faithfulness,' 'trustworthiness,' and 'reliability' of AI models in 'high-stakes' meteorological applications. The core contribution aims to prevent 'Self-Contradictory Reasoning' to ensure dependable AI assistants for domains where precision and trust are critical, which directly relates to ethical deployment and responsible AI in high-risk fields.
